# Workshop coding assistant instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for repository structure, prerequisites, commands, and review expectations.
Read [EXERCISE.md](../EXERCISE.md) and the assigned workshop issue before editing code.

Use JDK 21–26, Maven, Node.js 24+, and npm 11.16.0+.
Work on the participant's own branch. Gather evidence before diagnosing behavior, clarify feature requirements,
and add tests that demonstrate the intended outcome. Keep changes focused and preserve license and authorship notices.
Run `./refine lint`, `./refine build`, and the relevant tests. Report actual results and any validation you could not run.

Use [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the contribution workflow and the workshop repository for discussions.
